body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics today launched the new business netbook 'NB30' at CES 2010, which delivers up to 8.5 hour battery life.

The new netbooks' 10.1" LED back-lit anti-reflective display fine-tunes movies and images with the sharpest details and boldest colors, with no mirror effect under bright lights or in sunny weather. The NB30 offers added durability with a free-fall sensor that prevents hard drive damage and a specially designed durable casing.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
